en: The front image is a black-and-white photograph of a tree-lined avenue in a park, with tall, densely-leafed trees forming an arch over the pathway. The setting is tranquil and historical, evoking early-to-mid 20th-century European park design. Text on the postcard indicates the location as 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Parkalleen'. The back of the postcard includes the words 'Postkarte', a place for a stamp, publisher information, and a museum stamp indicating 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
